overview: Single-site, single-arm feasibility study of the four-part perioperative glucose protocol over nine months, with pre-specified progression criteria for a later randomised trial.
population: Adults with insulin-treated diabetes listed for elective general, orthopaedic or urological surgery with an expected stay of at least one night, from March to November 2027.
exposure: The protocol: dose-adjustment table at pre-assessment, nurse call two days before surgery, first-on-the-list scheduling for general surgery and urology only, subcutaneous correction scale for operations under three hours.
procedures: Eligible patients are identified at pre-assessment and invited. The nurse call is logged. Capillary glucose is recorded at admission, before induction, in recovery and four-hourly for 24 hours on a study chart, with laboratory confirmation of values below 4 mmol/L. A five-item patient questionnaire on consistency of instructions is completed before discharge.

outcomes.name: Recruitment rate
outcomes.measure: Proportion of eligible patients who consent; progression criterion at least 50 percent
outcomes.why: Decides whether a trial can recruit.

outcomes.name: Protocol delivery
outcomes.measure: Proportion receiving both the dose table and the nurse call; criterion at least 80 percent
outcomes.why: Decides whether the protocol can be delivered.

outcomes.name: Outcome completeness
outcomes.measure: Proportion with all scheduled capillary values documented; criterion at least 90 percent
outcomes.why: The criterion the retrieved pilot trial failed.

outcomes.name: Glucose out of range on the day of surgery
outcomes.measure: Any value above 12 or below 4 mmol/L, described with its interval
outcomes.why: Informs the trial's sample size; not an effect estimate.

feasibility: About 112 eligible patients in nine months; the nurse's 4 hours a week cover about 10 calls a week; the grant covers the study charts and a research nurse day each month.
biasMitigation: Consecutive eligible patients logged, including those not approached

biasFlags.label: Staff attention during the study
biasFlags.note: Delivery rates may be higher than in routine use.

parsimony.simplestPath: One site, one arm, three progression criteria.

theoreticalFramework: None; progression criteria carry the decision.
summary: Single-arm feasibility protocol with three progression criteria.
